responsibility: Implements intrinsic call lowering for the GCC backend by dispatching Rust intrinsics to libc functions, GCC builtins, SIMD-specific lowering, or custom codegen paths such as exception-catching shims, while validating signatures and storing results in backend values.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `back/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is a substantive implementation file for intrinsic lowering. Its source defines intrinsic dispatch (`codegen_intrinsic_call`), maps Rust intrinsics to GCC/libc builtins, and builds helper shims such as `__rust_try`, so its role is frontend-to-backend operation lowering rather than merely re-exporting backend submodules.
